cases.name: ok_develop
cases.pins: a valid develop release

cases.name: ok_main
cases.pins: a valid main release, first check ever (no seq seen, no stored revocations)

cases.name: ok_seq_equal
cases.pins: seq equal to the last seen is accepted (rerunning install.sh or a weekly refresh)

cases.name: ok_test_channel
cases.pins: the test key (channels ['test-*']) signs a test-<name> channel

cases.name: ok_revocations_older_stored
cases.pins: a newer revocation list than the stored one is accepted (and then stored)

cases.name: ok_outer_not_canonical
cases.pins: the outer envelope is not signed, so whitespace and key order there do not matter

cases.name: malformed_not_json
cases.pins: not JSON at all

cases.name: malformed_duplicate_key
cases.pins: a duplicate key in the outer envelope

cases.name: malformed_unknown_field_envelope
cases.pins: an unknown top-level envelope field

cases.name: malformed_unknown_field_manifest
cases.pins: a correctly signed, canonical manifest with an unknown field

cases.name: malformed_noncanonical_manifest
cases.pins: correctly signed manifest bytes that are not JCS (indented)

cases.name: malformed_noncanonical_cert
cases.pins: a root-signed certificate whose bytes are not JCS (key order)

cases.name: malformed_float_seq
cases.pins: seq is a JSON number with a fraction (floats are never allowed)

cases.name: malformed_base64_linebreak
cases.pins: payload base64 with a MIME line break (only canonical RFC 4648 base64, no whitespace, is accepted)

cases.name: malformed_file_name_traversal
cases.pins: a signed manifest whose file name is a path (names are bare file names)

cases.name: malformed_wrong_alg
cases.pins: sig.alg other than ed25519

cases.name: unknown_root
cases.pins: certificate signed by a root that is not in the trust set

cases.name: bad_cert_sig
cases.pins: certificate claims root-1 but is signed by another key

cases.name: bad_revocations_sig
cases.pins: revocation list claims root-1 but is signed by the release key

cases.name: revocations_rollback
cases.pins: the revocation list is older than the stored one (a held-back revocation)

cases.name: wrong_purpose_catalog_key
cases.pins: the add-on catalog key (purpose addon-catalog) signs a core manifest with the core domain

cases.name: channel_not_allowed
cases.pins: the test key (channels ['test-*']) signs a develop manifest

cases.name: cert_expired
cases.pins: now >= cert not_after

cases.name: cert_not_yet_valid
cases.pins: now < cert not_before

cases.name: key_revoked_min_serial
cases.pins: cert serial 1 < min_serial 2

cases.name: key_revoked_listed
cases.pins: cert serial 4 is on the revoked list

cases.name: key_mismatch
cases.pins: sig.key_id names another key than the certificate

cases.name: bad_sig_tampered_payload
cases.pins: payload changed after signing

cases.name: bad_sig_no_domain
cases.pins: signature over the payload without the domain prefix

cases.name: bad_sig_catalog_domain
cases.pins: the core key signs a core manifest under the catalog domain

cases.name: wrong_format_catalog_payload
cases.pins: the core key signs a catalog payload under the core domain; verified as core

cases.name: wrong_channel
cases.pins: a valid develop release fetched for channel main

cases.name: expired
cases.pins: now >= manifest expires_at

cases.name: rollback
cases.pins: seq 42 < seq_seen 43

cases.name: hash_mismatch
cases.pins: a downloaded file has the right size but another sha256

cases.name: size_mismatch
cases.pins: a downloaded file has another size
